name: HCAR
description: The HCAR, acronym for Heavy Counter-Assault Rifle, is the revision of a classic with new furniture. Intended for the civilian markets, it was made with Semi-Automatic fire only, but we are sure that the good fellas at R&D can put some Betty Boop and give you the extra firepower you might know the HCAR's old man for...if you put in the hours, that is. They only understand violence. So we show them violence. They have heavy caliber infantry, so we have those too. You think we fight this war with sticks and stones?
